protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No established or recommended human dose. Clinical studies used single SC doses of 0.02–3 mg/kg; a DMD trial was halted after epistaxis and telangiectasias. Page's 1 mg/mL dilution is concentration math only; discontinued investigational biologic, not a protocol.

schedule.description: Single SC dose range in a clinical trial; later DMD trial halted for epistaxis and telangiectasias.

regimen.notes: Historical trial exposure only; program discontinued for safety. This is not a recommended regimen.
